units.source_text: 1944年11月，B29型轰炸机第一次轰炸了东京，这时我想：也许明天京都也会遭到空袭。

en.t: In November 1944, when B-29 bombers attacked Tokyo for the first time, I thought: perhaps Kyoto too would be hit by an air raid tomorrow.

units.source_text: 我暗自幻想着京都全市被围在火海里。

en.t: In secret, I imagined the whole city of Kyoto surrounded by a sea of flames.

units.source_text: 这古都依然如故地过分地保护着古老的东西，以致许多神社佛阁忘却了其中产生过灼热的灰色的记忆。

en.t: This ancient capital, as always, protected old things to excess, so that many shrines and Buddhist temples had forgotten the scorching, gray memories that had once arisen within them.

units.source_text: 因为我想像着应仁大乱使这古都荒芜了的时候，就觉得由于京都忘却战火的不安太久，由此丧失了它的几分的美。

en.t: When I imagined the time when the Onin War had laid this ancient capital waste, I felt that Kyoto had forgotten the unease of war and fire for too long, and had thereby lost some measure of its beauty.
